rate.description: Annual rate as a decimal fraction, e.g. "0.145" for 14.5%/year

supplementsRunId.description: Required when runKind=SUPPLEMENTARY — the MAIN run this corrects

sourceSessionId.description: Links to a pay_cashier_session (FR-PAY-011.1) — reference only, no additional posting logic.

date.description: Raw column/key name carrying the line date

description.description: Raw column/key name carrying the line description

dateFormat.description: Token template built from YYYY/MM/DD, e.g. "YYYY-MM-DD" or "DD/MM/YYYY"

rawRows.description: Flat rows already parsed from the source file (CSV/XLSX parsing is out of this endpoint's scope)

rate.description: Decimal string, NUMERIC(9,6) — required when method='RB'

residualValue.description: Decimal string — derived from category.residual_pct × cost when omitted

downtimeNote.description: Defaults to '' (filled in progressively / at complete())

costExpenseVoucherId.description: An ALREADY-CREATED exp_voucher id — this service never creates one itself

gainLoss.description: Decimal string — proceeds minus NBV at disposal

assetIds.description: 'ALL' (every currently ACTIVE asset) or an explicit array of asset ids — see verification.service.ts's FaVerificationScope doc comment

missingAssetIds.description: Missing-asset write-off proposals — asset ids with found=false at post time. Act on each via POST /fixed-assets/disposals with method=WRITE_OFF.

cron.description: 5-field cron subset — "minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week", each "*" or an exact integer

recipients.description: Raw email addresses — non-email entries are skipped at delivery time

rows.description: Row shape is report-specific — see the report's own columns[] contract

permissionCode.description: The permission code that gates POST /reports/:code/execute for this report

params.description: Report-specific parameters — validated at runtime against the report's own declared paramsShape

secret.description: HMAC signing secret — encrypted at rest, never returned by any read endpoint

entityId.description: The local domain record id being synced

payload.description: Provider-shaped entity body — transported as-is, see the adapter's own doc comment

sizeBytes.description: Encrypted archive size in bytes (string — 64-bit safe)

target.description: An ALREADY-REACHABLE target Postgres connection (e.g. a scratch container) — provisioning the target itself is out of this endpoint's scope, see RestoreVerificationService's own doc comment

disk.description: Disk usage via fs.statfs — {available:false} on platforms/Node builds where it's unavailable

licenseState.description: STUB — Module 21 (Licensing) does not exist yet

queueDepths.description: N/A — no queue infrastructure wired up in this codebase yet

logLevel.description: Reflects LOG_LEVEL env var only — no runtime-mutable Logger abstraction exists yet
